name: Slag hound
description: a lean hunting hound of black slag with lava cracks glowing along its spine and ribs, ember eyes, the Magma King's dog

poses.stand: a lean hound of black slag standing in profile facing right, hunting-dog build, orange lava cracks glowing along its spine and ribs, ember eyes, low and ready
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, head thrown back in a snarl, lava cracks flaring white
poses.dead: collapsed in a heap of cooling black slag with a last glow fading

idle.action: stalks in place with a low prowl, head swaying, spine cracks pulsing

attack.action: crouches low on its haunches then lunges forward to the right with jaws open, cracks blazing, then lands

hurt.action: is struck, yelps and staggers, then regains its footing

die.action: cracks blaze white, it bursts apart into a shower of slag and embers
